title: Negotiation routing & pricing-concession playbook for MSA/DPA liability exceptions
creator: Priya Nair
description: Create a single source-of-truth playbook that ties enterprise MSA/DPA redline decisions to pricing/packaging concessions and an automated routing workflow. The goal is to reduce legal review time for common liability/indemnity exceptions, ensure consistent commercial trade-offs for pricing experiments, and integrate security questionnaire outcomes into the negotiation decision matrix. Deliverables: 1) decision matrix that maps redline categories to allowed concessions and pricing uplift thresholds, 2) automated routing rules for LegalOps/Finance/Security triage, 3) clause bank (approved fallback clauses) for Sales, and 4) onboarding/training for Sales and AE managers. This ticket focuses on policy and routing; clause drafting will be a follow-up with Legal to finalize language.
acceptance_criteria: Published playbook doc in Confluence with decision matrix and routing matrix
Routing rules implemented as Slack workflow + LegalOps Zendesk triage + GH ticket template
Clause bank (approved fallback clauses) uploaded to shared Drive with versioning guidance
Mapping between pricing experiment tiers and allowable liability caps documented and approved by Finance
Security questionnaire pass/fail signals integrated into routing (i.e., when a high-risk control is missing, route to Security for blocking/mitigations)
Two Sales onboarding sessions completed and feedback captured in the playbook
Legal sign-off obtained from outside counsel and internal GC
decisions: Use a scoring rubric (0-10) to quantify risk for each redline category: liability cap, indemnity, data deletion, audit rights, export controls
Allow Sales to approve low-risk redlines (score <=3) using pre-authorized concessions tied to pricing credit buckets
Any redline scoring >=7 must be routed directly to LegalOps + GC and blocks signature until approved
Pricing uplift thresholds: standard allowance for 10% discount to accept standard MSA; >10% requires Finance approval and explicit GC concurrence
Security questionnaires that hit any 'critical' control gaps will automatically mark the opportunity as 'Requires remediation' and route to Security and Legal
Fallback clause bank will be limited to 8 approved clauses to avoid clause proliferation; LegalOps will maintain version history
